bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
head=8f374cc9854c12b03a39d6048c8b2242ac5f67ca
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
oldid=sha256:44b7f6c83af3ef1d1cbba4f02caee10b39f63f6ddc2608d897a8386c2eb3a5d5
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/opus-8f374cc-stage-20261125"
newtag=create-videobot:opus-8f374cc-stage
rollbacktag=create-videobot:rollback-opus-8f374cc
compose="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f7cdc3b06c2e53f4d302f088daa39a5b449f7bdd
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.Names}}' | wc -l)" -eq 1
test -f "$compose"
test "$(wc -l < "$stage/changed.txt")" -eq 6
while IFS= read -r f; do
  test "$(sha256sum "$stage/live/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  git show "$head:$f" | cmp - "$stage/candidate/$f"
  cp "$stage/candidate/$f" "$stage/merged/$f"
done < "$stage/changed.txt"
# The two prior live conflicts were reviewed: the new real metadata-only editor replaces the old read-only rejection,
# while the receipt-backed lock, fresh entry, detached album, and legacy Details suppression are retained.
docker tag "$oldid" "$rollbacktag"
printf 'FROM %s\nCOPY merged/src/ /opt/videobot/src/\n' "$rollbacktag" > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$newtag" "$stage" > "$stage/build.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 "$stage/build.log"; exit 68; }
# Verify every versioned runtime source and SQL file, not only the changed six.
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$head" src sql | while IFS= read -r f; do
  expected="$(git show "$head:$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  actual="$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$newtag" "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  test "$expected" = "$actual" || { echo "CANDIDATE_FILE_MISMATCH $f"; exit 65; }
done
echo ALL_VERSIONED_RUNTIME_SOURCE_MATCHES_PR11
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node -w /opt/videobot -v "$stage/candidate/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" "$newtag" --test test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorMigrate.test.mjs test/creatorPollingStartup.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/videoRealFfmpeg.test.mjs test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs > "$stage/new.tap" 2>&1 || { tail -n 100 "$stage/new.tap"; exit 69; }
tail -n 12 "$stage/new.tap"
echo OPUS_STAGE_AND_SELECTED_TESTS_PASS
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/var/lib/videobot/sticker-entry"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_WORK_SOURCE="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/var/lib/videobot/media-work"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}')"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_DB_USER=//p' | head -n1)"
export VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL=//p' | head -n1)"
export CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL=//p' | head -n1)"
export GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range $name, $net := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $name}}{{end}}' | head -n1)"
mode="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEO_SALE_MODE=//p' | head -n1)"
test "$mode" = invoice
test -n "$VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE" && test -n "$VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE" && test -n "$VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE" && test -n "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER" && test -n "$GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK" && test -n "$CREATEVDOBOT_TERMS_URL"
test -d "$VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_WORK_SOURCE" && mountpoint -q /mnt/g
newOverride="$stage/compose.opus.yaml"
oldOverride="$stage/compose.rollback.yaml"
printf 'services:\n  videobot-poll:\n    image: %s\n    pull_policy: never\n    environment:\n      VIDEO_SALE_MODE: invoice\n' "$newtag" > "$newOverride"
printf 'services:\n  videobot-poll:\n    image: %s\n    pull_policy: never\n    environment:\n      VIDEO_SALE_MODE: invoice\n' "$rollbacktag" > "$oldOverride"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" -f "$newOverride" config --quiet
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" -f "$oldOverride" config --quiet
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$oldid"
armed=YES
rollback(){ docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" -f "$oldOverride" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap 'if test "$armed" = YES;then rollback;fi' EXIT
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" -f "$newOverride" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null
ready=NO
for n in $(seq 1 18); do
 if test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true && docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' && docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'STICKER_SHOP_HTTP_READY=PASS'; then ready=YES;break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = YES || { echo OPUS_POLLER_NOT_READY; exit 57; }
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect "$newtag" --format '{{.Id}}')"
while IFS= read -r f; do
 test "$(sha256sum "$stage/merged/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
done < "$stage/changed.txt"
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.Names}}' | wc -l)" -eq 1
armed=NO
trap - EXIT
echo OPUS_RUNTIME_DEPLOYED_AND_READBACK_PASS
printf 'DEPLOYED_IMAGE='; docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}'
echo INVOICE_MODE_PRESERVED
echo EXISTING_DB_AND_PUBLIC_POSTS_NOT_DIRECTLY_MUTATED
